offline.message: You are offline. Some things may not be up to date.

signup.title: Create your family
signup.intro: You become the family's first parent and can then add the rest of the family.

fields.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: letters a–z, digits, '.', '-' or '_'. Used to sign in.
fields.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown in the app instead of the username.

members.title: Members
members.passwordSaved: The password was changed. They have been signed out on all devices.
members.setPasswordHint: At least {{min}} characters. They will be signed out on all devices.
members.removeBody: They can no longer sign in, and their username becomes free. Their history is kept.

chores.title: Chores
chores.emptyParent: There are no chores yet. Add the first one!
chores.archiveBody: The chore leaves the library. Chores already started can still be finished, and you can restore it later.
chores.archivedNotice: This chore is archived and not in the library.
chores.multiplierHint: A whole number from 1 to 100. The chore is worth this many base points.
chores.stepsHint: Most chores have a single step. Steps are done in this order.
chores.repeatIntervalHint: Optional. From 15 minutes to 7 days, until the step is done.
chores.delayCleared: {{title}} is now the first step, so its reminder was removed.

home.noRecent: No chores have been done recently.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.

username.invalid: Use 3–32 characters: letters a–z, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.

password.too_short: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.

email.not_allowed: A child cannot have an email address.

captcha.invalid: Please complete the check that you are not a robot.

signin.failed: The username or password is incorrect.

member.last_parent: A family must keep at least one parent.
member.email_required: A parent needs an email address.
member.email_not_allowed: A child cannot have an email address.

errors.concurrency_conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only a parent can do this.

chore.title_invalid: A title of 1 to 100 characters is required.
chore.description_too_long: The description can be at most 1000 characters.
chore.multiplier_out_of_range: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.
chore.no_steps: A chore needs at least one step.
chore.too_many_steps: A chore can have at most 20 steps.
chore.archived: This chore has been archived. Restore it before editing.

step.title_invalid: A step needs a title of 1 to 100 characters.
step.description_too_long: The description can be at most 1000 characters.
step.first_has_delay: The first step cannot have a reminder.
step.interval_without_delay: Set a reminder before repeating it.

attempt.not_open: This chore is no longer in progress.
attempt.not_current_step: That step is not the current one.
attempt.not_complete: Only a complete chore can be rejected.
attempt.rejection_window_closed: It is too late to reject this chore.
attempt.rejection_reason_too_long: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

family.base_points_out_of_range: Use a whole number from 1 to 1000.

settings.title: Family settings
settings.basePointsHint: What one standard chore is worth, from 1 to 1000. A chore with multiplier ×2 is worth twice this.
settings.attemptWindowHint: A chore not finished within this many days of starting is abandoned and earns nothing. From 1 to 30. Applies to chores started from now on.

attempts.restartBody: Every step goes back to not done. The chore still counts for the day you started it.
attempts.cancelBody: The chore is removed and earns no points.
attempts.abandonedNotice: This chore was not finished in time and earns no points.
attempts.reloaded: The chore was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded.
